title: Bias-variance decompositions: the exclusive privilege of Bregman divergences
abstract: arXiv:2501.18581v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Bias-variance decompositions are widely used to understand the generalization performance of machine learning models. While the squared error loss permits a straightforward decomposition, other loss functions - such as zero-one loss or $L_1$ loss - either fail to sum bias and variance to the expected loss or rely on definitions that lack the essential properties of meaningful bias and variance. Recent research has shown that clean decompositions can be achieved for the broader class of Bregman divergences, with the cross-entropy loss as a special case. However, the necessary and sufficient conditions for these decompositions remain an open question.   In this paper, we address this question by studying continuous, nonnegative loss functions that satisfy the identity of indiscernibles (zero loss if and only if the two arguments are identical), under mild regularity conditions. translated_title: 偏差-方差分解：Bregman散度的专属特权
translated_abstract: 偏差-方差分解被广泛用于理解机器学习模型的泛化性能。虽然平方误差损失允许一个直观 straightforward 的分解，但其他损失函数——例如0-1损失或 $L_1$ 损失——要么无法使偏差与方差之和等于期望损失，要么其所依赖的定义缺乏有意义偏差和方差应具备的基本性质。最近的研究表明，对于更广泛的Bregman散度类（交叉熵损失作为其特例），可以实现“干净”的分解。然而，这类分解的充要条件仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们在温和的正则性条件下，通过研究满足不可分辨同一性（当且仅当两个参数相同时损失为零）的连续、非负损失函数来回答这一问题。我们证明了所谓的 $g$-Bregman 散度或 rho-tau 散度
tldr: 本文在温和正则条件下证明，Bregman散度（即 $g$-Bregman/rho-tau 散度）是唯一能实现干净偏差-方差分解的连续非负损失函数类，从而回答了此类分解的充要条件问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Bregman divergences (i.e., g-Bregman/rho-tau divergences) are the unique class of continuous nonnegative loss functions admitting clean bias-variance decompositions, resolving the open question of necessary and sufficient conditions for such decompositions.
